cues.en: The goal of this video is to learn how to use Python to implement basic arithmetic.
cues.zh: 這段影片的目標，是學會用 Python 實作基本算術。

cues.en: Essentially we are going to use python as a calculator and it's easier than you might think.
cues.zh: 基本上就是把 Python 當計算機，比你想的還簡單。

cues.en: So let's jump straight into it.
cues.zh: 直接開始吧。

cues.en: Once you have a fresh Jupiter notebook open you can click inside this small window here and then write out some arithmetic equations just like you would with a calculator.
cues.zh: 開啟一份新的 Jupyter Notebook，點進這個小視窗，就能像使用計算機一樣，寫下算術式。

cues.en: So let's say for example four plus five.
cues.zh: 例如 4 加 5。

cues.en: Now I know that the answer has to be nine because I am a genius mathematician and to confirm that the answer is going to be nine.
cues.zh: 我知道答案一定是 9，因為我是天才數學家。為了確認答案是 9，

cues.en: I'm going to press on keyboard control and then enter and that gives me an output of nine.
cues.zh: 按鍵盤上的 Ctrl，再按 Enter，輸出就會是 9。

cues.en: And you can change these numbers as you like.
cues.zh: 你可以任意修改這些數字。

cues.en: So I could set this to be four plus eight.
cues.zh: 例如改成 4 加 8，

cues.en: I'm just overwriting the five with an eight.
cues.zh: 直接把 5 改寫成 8。

cues.en: And again I press control enter and now I see that four plus eight is twelve.
cues.zh: 再按 Ctrl+Enter，就能看到 4 加 8 是 12。

cues.en: Now I want another one of these input bars here.
cues.zh: 現在我想再加一個這種輸入區。

cues.en: So I'm going to press shift enter instead of control enter and that will evaluate this equation and
cues.zh: 這次按 Shift+Enter，而不是 Ctrl+Enter，這會計算算式，

cues.en: it will also give me a new line here and now I'm going to show you that you can add multiple numbers at the same time.
cues.zh: 也會新增一個儲存格。接下來示範同時加上多個數字。

cues.en: Let's say four plus 1 and this is going to give me five.
cues.zh: 例如 4 加 1，會得到 5。

cues.en: But then I'm going to say plus five.
cues.zh: 但我再加上 5，

cues.en: And so that result should be 10.
cues.zh: 所以結果應該是 10。

cues.en: So that's for addition.
cues.zh: 以上是加法。

cues.en: Now we get to subtraction.
cues.zh: 現在來看減法。

cues.en: And again it's exactly how you think it should work.
cues.zh: 做法一樣，就是你想的那樣，

cues.en: But with the minus sign instead of the plus sign.
cues.zh: 把加號換成減號。

cues.en: So I'm going to say let's go five minus three.
cues.zh: 例如寫 5 減 3。

cues.en: And now I press control enter and that gives me a two.
cues.zh: 按 Ctrl+Enter，就得到 2。

cues.en: So far pretty easy. One thing I would like to point out already is you'll notice that spaces are not important here.
cues.zh: 目前很簡單。先提醒一點，注意這裡的空白不影響結果。

cues.en: You will see later when we get to control statements like if statements and for loops that sometimes in Python spacing is important.
cues.zh: 之後學到 if 陳述式、for 迴圈等控制陳述式時，會看到 Python 有些情況很重視空白。

cues.en: But here spacing is not important.
cues.zh: 但這裡空白不重要。

cues.en: So I can say with no spaces or with spaces I can even have lots and lots of spaces.
cues.zh: 不加空白、加空白，甚至加很多空白都可以。

cues.en: This is probably too many spaces but the answer is still two.
cues.zh: 這個空白可能太多了，但答案仍然是 2。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now let's move on to multiplication.
cues.zh: 接著看乘法。

cues.en: Now you might think that multiplication should be something with an X because this is probably how you would write it down if you're writing down three times three on a piece of paper or if you see the expression
cues.zh: 你可能覺得乘法應該用 x，因為在紙上寫 3 乘以 3，或在課本看到，

cues.en: three times three in a textbook then it's going to be written down with an x.
cues.zh: 3 乘以 3，通常會用 x 形狀的乘號。

cues.en: However that is not the correct way to do it in Python and you can see you when I tried to run this so by pressing control enter.
cues.zh: 但 Python 裡不能這樣寫。我按 Ctrl+Enter 試著執行，

cues.en: We see this error message.
cues.zh: 就會出現這個錯誤訊息。

cues.en: So it says there's an error and it shows me this little carrot here indicating where on the line the error happens and the error message says Syntax Error Invalid syntax.
cues.zh: 它說有錯誤，並用這個小尖角符號，指出這一行出錯的位置。訊息是 SyntaxError: invalid syntax。

cues.en: Now sometimes in programming languages like Python the error messages are more useful, and sometimes they are not quite as easy to interpret.
cues.zh: 像 Python 這類程式語言，有些錯誤訊息比較有用，有些不太容易理解。

cues.en: But in this case I know the problem: X is not the multiplication sign.
cues.zh: 這次我知道問題：x 不是乘法符號。

cues.en: Instead the multiplication sign is an asterisk it's this little star here.
cues.zh: 乘法要用星號，也就是這個小星星。

cues.en: So now I'm going to press control enter and then we get an output of nine, which is indeed three times three.
cues.zh: 現在按 Ctrl+Enter，輸出是 9，確實就是 3 乘以 3。

cues.en: So far I've only been implementing one operation -- one arithmetic operation -- per line of code per cell
cues.zh: 目前每行程式碼、每個儲存格，我只做一種算術運算，

cues.en: but you can also mix these together so I'm going to say three times three plus one.
cues.zh: 但也能混合使用。例如寫 3 乘以 3，再加 1，

cues.en: And how about minus five.
cues.zh: 再減 5 如何？

cues.en: So three times three is nine plus one is ten and then minus five gives me five.
cues.zh: 3 乘以 3 是 9，加 1 是 10，再減 5，得到 5。

cues.en: And here you see the answer is five.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到答案是 5。

cues.en: Now if you're having multiple operators in the same line you have to be careful about something called
cues.zh: 如果同一行有多個運算子，就得注意一件事，叫做，

cues.en: the order of operations. The order of operations is which arithmetic operator gets implemented first.
cues.zh: 運算順序，也就是哪個算術運算子會先執行。

cues.en: So this is three times three and then plus one and not three times three plus one which would be 12.
cues.zh: 這裡是先算 3 乘以 3，再加 1；不是 3 乘以括號裡的 3 加 1，後者會得到 12。

cues.en: This would be three times four.
cues.zh: 後者就是 3 乘以 4。

cues.en: There's gonna be a whole separate video dedicated to order of operations and how to override order of operations using parentheses.
cues.zh: 之後會有一段影片，專門介紹運算順序，以及如何用括號改變順序。

cues.en: So for now just keep in mind that order of operations is something important to keep in mind when doing
cues.zh: 目前先記住，用 Python 做算術時，運算順序，

cues.en: arithmetic with Python and I will talk more about it in a few videos.
cues.zh: 是重要的考量。過幾段影片會再詳細說明。

cues.en: The last arithmetic operation that I'm going to discuss in this video is division.
cues.zh: 這段影片最後要討論的算術運算，是除法。

cues.en: Now the way that division works is kind of like forming a fraction.
cues.zh: 除法的寫法有點像分數。

cues.en: So what you want to do is convert every division into a numerator and denominator and make that be a fraction and then you use this slash operator.
cues.zh: 把除法改寫成有分子、分母的分數，再使用這個斜線運算子。

cues.en: So for example three divided by four looks like this.
cues.zh: 例如 3 除以 4，像這樣。

cues.en: It's like you're writing out the fraction three fourths. So we can see that is point seven five and you have to be careful that it's the forward slash and not the backslash.
cues.zh: 就像寫出四分之三，可以看到結果是 0.75。要注意，使用正斜線，不是反斜線。

cues.en: So if you did the wrong slash if you did it this way then that's going to give you an error.
cues.zh: 如果斜線用錯，寫成這樣，就會出現錯誤。

cues.en: Again this is maybe not the most informative error but in this case I do know that we are trying to do division.
cues.zh: 這個錯誤可能也不是最有幫助的，不過我知道這裡要做的是除法。

cues.en: So it seems reasonable to suspect that we might be using the other slash operator here.
cues.zh: 所以，合理的懷疑是：也許該換成另一種斜線運算子。

cues.en: So that looks nice.
cues.zh: 這樣就對了。

cues.en: The last thing that I want to point out before getting to the exercises for this video is using parentheses for implementing arithmetic like this.
cues.zh: 進入練習前，最後想提醒的是，在這種算術式裡使用括號。

cues.en: The main use of parentheses is to group certain numbers together.
cues.zh: 括號主要用來把某些數字分成同一組。

cues.en: There are other uses of parentheses in Python and you will learn about those later in the course.
cues.zh: Python 裡括號還有其他用途，之後會學到。

cues.en: So for example let's say we wanted to compute one plus three divided by four.
cues.zh: 例如，我們想計算 1 加 3 除以 4。

cues.en: So if you would say one plus three divided by four.
cues.zh: 如果寫成 1 加 3 除以 4，

cues.en: The answer here is actually one point seventy five and that makes sense because python is grouping these two together and then it's adding of the one. Again, that's because of the order of operations which you
cues.zh: 答案其實是 1.75，這很合理，因為 Python 會先把這兩個數字做運算，再加上 1。這也是運算順序的緣故，

cues.en: will learn about later.
cues.zh: 之後會再介紹。

cues.en: But if you want the one plus three to be in the numerator then you would use parentheses like this.
cues.zh: 但如果希望 1 加 3 全部都在分子，就要像這樣用括號。

cues.en: Now you are specifically telling Python to group these two numbers together in this operation and then divide by four.
cues.zh: 你明確告訴 Python，把這兩個數字的運算放在同一組，再除以 4。

cues.en: And it might even be useful to use the spacing here to indicate that.
cues.zh: 也可以利用空白，讓這件事更明顯。

cues.en: Now we have one plus three grouped together divided by four.
cues.zh: 現在把 1 加 3 放在同一組，再除以 4。

cues.en: And of course the answer here is going to be one because one plus three is four divided by four is one.
cues.zh: 答案當然是 1，因為 1 加 3 是 4，4 除以 4 是 1。

cues.en: There are two exercises for this video and that is basically to implement these two expressions here and figure out what the answers are.
cues.zh: 這段影片有兩個練習，基本上就是實作這兩個運算式，算出答案。

cues.en: So what I encourage you to do now is pause the video write out these equations in Python and make sure
cues.zh: 我鼓勵你現在暫停影片，在 Python 寫出算式，確認，

cues.en: you get the right answer. So pause the video, have a go at it, and then come back to the video and you can watch me solve these two problems
cues.zh: 得到正確答案。暫停、自己試試，再回來看我解這兩題。

cues.en: okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So I'm going to give myself a new cell here.
cues.zh: 我先新增一個儲存格。

cues.en: So here was the first problem it was five minus...
cues.zh: 第一題是 5 減去，

cues.en: and now I'm going to use parentheses just to make sure that we are doing the right thing.
cues.zh: 這裡我用括號，確保運算方式正確。

cues.en: So two divided by four times the fraction three divided by five.
cues.zh: 2 除以 4，再乘上 3 除以 5 這個分數。

cues.en: And the answer there is four point seven.
cues.zh: 答案是 4.7。

cues.en: And then the second problem was four minus five divided by....
cues.zh: 第二題是 4 減 5，再除以，

cues.en: and this one's a little bit tricky because the wrong way to do this would be to say three plus five times six.
cues.zh: 這題稍微有點難，錯誤寫法是直接接 3 加 5 乘以 6。

cues.en: And the reason why that's wrong it's sort of visually looks like it should be right.
cues.zh: 這樣在視覺上似乎合理，但其實不對，

cues.en: But python is going to group these numbers together this operation together and then it's going to add five times six.
cues.zh: 因為 Python 會先把這些數字、這個運算放在一起，再加上 5 乘以 6。

cues.en: But we want three plus five times six all to be in the denominator.
cues.zh: 我們要的是，3 加 5 乘以 6 全部放在分母。

cues.en: So now I'm going to put those in parentheses and that gives me a funny looking answer of minus zero
cues.zh: 所以加上括號，得到一個奇怪的答案，負 0，

cues.en: point 0 3 0 3 0 3 0 3 and so on is pretty funny number. So in this video I showed you how to implement basic
cues.zh: 點 03030303，一直重複，很有趣的數字。這段影片示範了如何實作基本，

cues.en: arithmetic in Python essentially using python as a calculator. Of course python is way way way more powerful
cues.zh: 算術，基本上就是把 Python 當計算機。當然 Python 強大得多，

cues.en: than just a basic calculator but that's the way to start. In the next video, you're going to learn how to use variables in place of numbers.
cues.zh: 不只是一台基本計算機，但這是起點。下一段影片，你會學到用變數代替數字，

cues.en: And that's going to help bring you to a new level of using Python to learn mathematics.
cues.zh: 讓你用 Python 學數學的能力，更上一層樓。
